synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints ALL PASS: all 27 transitions replay exactly.

I put these rules in `program.py`:

| Action | Rule |
|---|---|
| 4 | Move the cursor to the next legend slot, left to right. At the end of a row, go to the next row. From the last row, go back to the first row. |
| 3 | Move the cursor to the previous slot, with the same wrap. |
| 1, 2 | No change. |
| Others | No change. |

A "slot" is a group of legends in one row that are 2 cells apart or less. The cursor stops on the first legend of each slot, 4 cells above it. This rule explains why the cursor never stops on the legends at x=27: each one is 2 cells to the right of the legend at x=20.

These parts of the rule are not confirmed by the data:
- **Group rule:** Nothing else in the data makes the x=27 legends different, so the "2 cells or less" limit is my guess.
- **Actions 1 and 2:** They may change legend colours. The extractor gives no pixel data, so I cannot see this.
- **Action 3:** There is only one observation of it, inside a row. Its wrap between rows is a guess.
- **Untested actions:** There are no observations of actions 5, 6 (click) or 7.
